message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Platform (web app) → Containers → Container List → filter + pick your columns, and Insights → Pickup Insights → switch graph to table view, then save each view/report from your browser. What lands on disk is per-view report files, the platform presents data as graphs and tables, but there's no documented one-click workspace-wide export, and raw 15-minute sensor readings aren't downloadable from the UI.

Please let me know if you have any questions. Place this data in a folder named Nordsense
notes: No documented one-click workspace-wide export; reports are saved per view.
Raw 15-minute sensor readings are not downloadable from the UI.
